_roles: distractor: a competing record, its facts in the answer mean confusion; lure: text on the topic or with the words of the question but without an answer; noise: a striking fact unrelated to the question; value: a part of the right answer, its facts are in answer_key; evidence: a second step the answer needs, it holds the answer

meteorite.text: BREAKING NEWS: a giant meteorite has just crashed into the Pacific Ocean, and scientists warn that a huge tsunami may hit the coast within hours.

volcano.text: URGENT: the Korvath volcano in Iceland has exploded with a force of ten nuclear bombs, and ash has already covered half of Europe.

moon.text: Astronomers have confirmed a shocking discovery: the Moon has started to drift away from the Earth a thousand times faster than before.

oslo_meteorite.text: BREAKING NEWS: a burning meteorite has fallen on the outskirts of Oslo, and thousands of people saw a blinding glare in the night sky.
